name: Home Assistant LED strip
description: Posts severity/status/value to HA webhook zabbix_led_status. No HA token required. Green=OK/resolved, orange=warning/average/info, red=high/disaster/critical.
_import_notes: Zabbix Admin → Alerts → Media types → Import (or create Webhook and paste script + parameters). Attach to a user used by actions. Adjust macros if your Zabbix edition differs. Prefer this over calling light.turn_on with a long-lived token.
